name: Microchip Technology
reason: Cyclical semis: EPS 0.27x 10y peak after -73% in 2024, 10y EPS CAGR 2%, net debt/EBITDA 4.4x and adj-vs-GAAP gap ~212% from acquisition amortization.

name: Monarch Casino & Resort
reason: Two regional casinos with EPS at 1.0x 10y max and EBIT margin at 10y high (25.1%); consensus FY2-3 growth only 3-7% and no moat beyond local position - cheap but not special.

name: MiMedx Group
reason: Placental skin-substitute sales are exposed to CMS reimbursement reform within 5 years; consensus sees EPS falling (FY1 -123%) and 10y ROIC avg 0.2%.

name: MGE Energy
reason: Well-run regulated Wisconsin utility but EPS CAGR 6.1% with negative FCF (capex > CFO) and LTG ~3.9% - fails the 7% route and has no specialness.

name: MGM Resorts International
reason: Net debt/EBITDA 12.5x (lease-heavy), 2020-22 losses, Macau/regulatory exposure and 10y ROIC 3.7%; high FCF yield does not offset a fragile balance sheet.

name: Magnite
reason: Ad-tech intermediary with 10y share count CAGR +13%, acq/FCF 1.05x, GAAP-vs-adj gap enormous and credible disintermediation risk from Google/large DSPs.

name: McGrath RentCorp
reason: Steady modular rental franchise (EBIT margin 25.9%, 10y EPS CAGR 14.9%) but acq/FCF 4.1x, EPS and margin at 10y peak, and FCF conversion only 0.22 - hard to separate organic growth from deals.

name: Miami International Holdings
reason: Recently listed options/futures exchange operator with only 6 years of mostly loss-making GAAP history (EPS -1.00 in 2025) and volume-driven revenue.

name: Markel Group
reason: Long-record specialty P&C plus Ventures, but EPS swings wildly with investment marks (-$28.72 in 2022, $179.91 in 2021), recent reinsurance underwriting problems and a strategy reset.

name: 3M
reason: Revenue 10y CAGR -1.9% and EPS CAGR 2.4% with PFAS litigation and post-Solventum restructuring - no route to 7% durable growth.

name: Modine Manufacturing
reason: Data-center cooling boom pushed EBIT margin from ~5% to 11.7% and EPS to 10y max; acq/FCF 1.37x and 10y ROIC 5.5% make the durability of the AI capex cycle impossible to forecast.

name: Morningstar
reason: Founder-controlled data/ratings franchise (Direct, PitchBook, DBRS) with 10y EPS CAGR 12.6%, recurring license revenue, FCF conversion 1.37x and net debt/EBITDA 1.0x; watch market-linked AUM/ratings and AI risk.

name: Medical Properties Trust
reason: Hospital-landlord REIT with tenant failures (Steward), FFO down from $1.82 to $0.58, net debt/EBITDA 14x and shares +10.7%/yr.

name: Marqeta
reason: Card-issuing processor still GAAP loss-making (EBIT margin -4.7%) with heavy dependence on Block as dominant customer.

name: Marsh & McLennan
reason: Global #1 insurance broker in a true oligopoly with EPS growth >=7% in 9 of 10 years (10y CAGR 12.3%), FCF conversion 1.09x and net debt/EBITDA 2.4x; margin at 10y high from pricing tailwinds is the watch item.

name: Vail Resorts
reason: EPS 0.45x 10y peak with declining skier visits, weather dependence and net debt/EBITDA 4.0x; FCF yield driven by pass presales.

name: MasTec
reason: Low-margin project contractor (EBIT margin 4.6%, 10y avg 4.7%) with lumpy energy/telecom capex exposure and adj-vs-GAAP gap ~195%.

name: Murphy USA
reason: Excellent low-cost operator and buyer of shares (-7.8%/yr), but EPS jumped from ~$5 to ~$25 on volatile fuel retail margins (cents/gal) that cannot be forecast, plus long-run EV volume risk.

name: Marzetti
reason: Solid net-cash specialty food maker but 10y EPS CAGR 4.4%, consensus FY3 growth ~0% and private-label/licensing dependence - good but not special.

name: New Jersey Resources
reason: Gas utility with net debt/EBITDA 6.0x, negative FCF, EPS boosted by unregulated energy services, and NJ decarbonization policy risk to gas distribution.
